remarks:
Welcome to this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 1-bath ranch home situated on 2.3 acres in the desirable Starpoint School District. Move-in ready & thoughtfully updated, this property offers a combination of modern improvements, comfortable living space, privacy, & convenient access to nearby amenities. The heart of the home is the newly renovated kitchen, featuring brand-new cabinetry, countertops, flooring, stainless steel appliances, & a spacious island with pendant lighting. The kitchen provides both functionality & style while offering plenty of workspace & storage. The large living room features a new picture window that fills the space with natural light, recessed lighting, & luxury vinyl flooring that continues throughout much of the home. Fresh, neutral paint throughout creates a clean & inviting feel. Major updates include a complete tear-off roof on both the house & garage in 2026, replacement windows throughout, a new hot water tank, & a new dishwasher. The bathroom was renovated in 2023, while the furnace, ductwork, & central air conditioning were replaced in 2020. A basement French drain was added in 2023 for additional peace of mind.
The home offers easy access to the outdoors with a covered rear deck overlooking the private, peaceful backyard. With 2.3 acres and no rear neighbors, there is plenty of room to enjoy the property, garden, entertain, or simply take in the surrounding setting. The property also provides access to Tonawanda Creek, adding to the outdoor appeal. A major highlight is the 4-car heated garage, providing exceptional space for vehicles, storage, hobbies, a workshop, or recreational equipment. The garage is complemented by a concrete driveway for convenient parking. Location is another key feature, with the beautiful Erie Canal pathway just a 5-minute walk away and convenient access to Millersport Highway for commuting, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities. With extensive recent updates, a spacious lot, a private setting, and an impressive 4-car heated garage, this home offers a move-in-ready opportunity in the Starpoint School District. Showings begin immediately. Seller reserves the right to set a deadline for offers.
